description: Arizona State Senator Mark Finchem joined Newsmax following Arizona’s Republican primary to discuss the momentum heading into the general election and the issues he says matter most to Arizona voters. During the interview, Finchem criticized Governor Katie Hobbs’ record number of vetoes, arguing that Arizonans are looking for leadership that gets results instead of obstructing
